title: PhlimboV3's committed APY is proven only inside the `_isConfigured` gate a resume skips; neither Phase 7 nor VerifyPromotionReady ever reads `v3.desiredAPYBps()` or `v3.apySetInProgress()`
originBasis: Exact fingerprint 7bec406d… absent. No ledger entry names _setDesiredAPYTwoStep or reads desiredAPYBps/apySetInProgress. ea648ec5ea is the MECHANISM (local-pass progress-file stamping) PR24-02 depends on, not the same defect. entryPoint promotion-ready:resume has NO baseline — COLD this run. NEW.
specConformanceDeviation: Autonomous Decision 2's non-vacuous proof (require(!apySetInProgress()) at :1826-1832) is the story's stated remedy for a vacuous read-back, but it lives inside the `if (!_isConfigured("p4e_v3_apy"))` gate a :resume skips, and neither Phase 7 nor VerifyPromotionReady re-proves it - so the story's stated assurance does not hold on the resume path it also documents.
specConformanceStoryText: Story 076 Autonomous Decision 2 (the desiredAPYBps() == bps read-back is vacuous when bps == 0; require(!p.apySetInProgress()) added so a missed 100-block commit window fails loudly).
description: Story 076 Autonomous Decision 2 correctly identifies that `desiredAPYBps() == bps` is a vacuous read-back when `bps == 0` (both real cases here), and adds `require(!p.apySetInProgress())` at :1826-1832 so a missed 100-block commit window fails loudly. That non-vacuous proof lives entirely inside `_setDesiredAPYTwoStep`, which Phase 4e calls only from within `if (!_isConfigured("p4e_v3_apy"))` (:1684-1688). `_trackConfig("p4e_v3_apy")` is stamped into the progress file during forge's LOCAL pass (`_trackConfig` -> `_writeProgressFileWithStatus`, :3009-3015), i.e. BEFORE either `setDesiredAPY` transaction is dispatched. If the second (commit) transaction is rejected or dropped on the Ledger, the progress file already records the step as done, a `:resume` skips it, and PhlimboV3 is left latched mid-preview with the APY uncommitted. Grep over both script files confirms `v3.desiredAPYBps()` appears nowhere in Phase 7 or `VerifyPromotionReady` (:2419 checks V2 only), and `apySetInProgress()` appears nowhere outside `_setDesiredAPYTwoStep`. Phase 8's `_probePhlimboV3StakeClaim` cannot substitute: it is preview-only AND it deliberately ARMS its own 1000-bps probe APY whenever it reads 0 (:2530-2535), so it masks exactly this failure.
impact: Today the mirrored target is 0 (verified live: `PhlimboV2.desiredAPYBps() == 0`), so a missed commit leaves V3 at 0 — the same value it was going to be set to, and the impact is confined to a stuck `apySetInProgress` latch. The defect is structural, not conditional: if V2's APY is ever retuned non-zero before the Ledger session (the script deliberately mirrors it live, :1685), a resume leg would leave PhlimboV3 emitting nothing while every post-cutover assertion and the whole verifier report read green. That is the exact silent-failure shape story 076 exists to close on the mint side.
evidence: side-effects.json.assertionCoverage.v3ApyAssertion; grep of `desiredAPYBps|apySetInProgress` over script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol and script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol (full result set, not truncated) — the only assertions are :1823/:1827 (inside the setter) and :2419 (V2 only). Live read at block 25678182: `PhlimboV2.desiredAPYBps() == 0`, `apySetInProgress() == false`.
recommendation: Add two `view` assertions to `_phase7_phlimboV3Assertions` so `VerifyPromotionReady` inherits them: `require(!IPhlimboAPYLike(newPhlimboV3).apySetInProgress(), "PhlimboV3 left latched mid-preview - the APY commit never landed")` and `require(IPhlimboAPYLike(newPhlimboV3).desiredAPYBps() == IPhlimboV2Like(PHLIMBO_V2).desiredAPYBps(), "PhlimboV3 APY does not mirror V2's")`. Note the second must be sequenced against step 11 (which zeroes V2), so either capture the mirrored target as a write-once baseline alongside `phlimboV2StakedAtCutover`, or assert only the latch. Add the same `!apySetInProgress()` check for PhlimboV2 next to the existing :2419 check.

relatedFindings.relationship: mechanism dependency — PR24-02 s trigger is L-03 s local-pass progress-file stamping (p4e_v3_apy is marked done before either setDesiredAPY tx dispatches). PR24-02 is the CONSEQUENCE on a specific control, not a restatement of the stamping defect

classification.assetImpact: None. Assurance coverage gap on PhlimboV3's APY commit.
attackPath: 1. Story 076 Autonomous Decision 2 correctly replaces the vacuous desiredAPYBps() == bps read-back with require(!p.apySetInProgress()) at :1826-1832 - the only non-vacuous proof the commit leg landed.
2. That proof lives entirely inside _setDesiredAPYTwoStep, which Phase 4e calls only from within if (!_isConfigured("p4e_v3_apy")) (:1684-1688).
3. _trackConfig stamps p4e_v3_apy into the progress file during forge's LOCAL pass (:3009-3015), i.e. before either setDesiredAPY transaction is dispatched.

4. If the commit transaction is rejected or dropped on the Ledger, the progress file already records the step done; a :resume skips it and PhlimboV3 is left latched mid-preview with the APY uncommitted.

5. Neither Phase 7 nor VerifyPromotionReady ever reads v3.desiredAPYBps() or v3.apySetInProgress() (:2419 checks V2 only), and Phase 8's _probePhlimboV3StakeClaim cannot substitute - it is preview-only AND deliberately ARMS its own 1000-bps probe APY whenever it reads 0 (:2530-2535), masking exactly this failure.
classification.likelihood: Structural and unconditional as a coverage gap; its harmful leg is empty today because the mirrored target is 0 (PhlimboV2.desiredAPYBps == 0 at block 25678182), so a missed commit leaves V3 at the value it was going to be set to, and the residue is a stuck apySetInProgress latch.
classification.assumptions: Assumes V2's APY remains 0 through cutover. The script mirrors it live at :1685, so this is observed, not pinned.
classification.externalRequirements: A dropped/rejected commit transaction on the Ledger, plus a resume leg.
classification.whyNotMedium: With the mirrored target at 0, a missed commit produces the same end value; the shape is a masked latch, not an impaired function. If V2's APY were retuned non-zero, a resume would leave PhlimboV3 emitting nothing while the whole verifier reads green - re-weigh then, on the same trigger recorded for L-02.

justification: LOW. Verification-coverage defect, not a design objection - KI #4 blesses the two-step mechanism, and this finding accepts it. No value moves; the worst current outcome is a latched flag and a green report that did not prove the property. Correctly kept separate from L-05/PR24-01: that fix (adding a V2 pause assertion) leaves v3.apySetInProgress() and v3.desiredAPYBps() just as unread.
regressionBasis: origin=new, carryoverOf=null, ledgerMatch=null, and the sanitizer's independent carryover re-check found no `fixed` entry matching this fingerprint. Not a regression.
severityHintDisposition: CONFIRMED at low after independent re-derivation; the hint was not accepted on trust. See justification.

knownIssueConsiderations.knownIssue: KI #4 (two-step APY setting process is an intentional security feature)
knownIssueConsiderations.why: CALIBRATION CHECK PASSED. PR24-02 raises no objection to the two-step mechanism; it accepts it as intended and observes that the only non-vacuous proof the commit leg landed (require(!apySetInProgress()) at :1826-1832) sits inside `if (!_isConfigured("p4e_v3_apy"))`, which a :resume skips, and that Phase 8's probe ARMS its own 1000-bps APY when it reads 0 (:2530-2535), masking the failure. That is a verification-coverage defect about the two-step feature, not a design objection to it. KI #4 blesses the feature, not the absence of a resume-surviving assertion on its outcome. Not suppressed.
No admin discretion involved; the gap is structural in the script.

c4ValidityScreen: No known-invalid class applies. Root cause demonstrated (grep of desiredAPYBps|apySetInProgress over both script files returns only :1823/:1827 inside the setter and :2419 on V2) plus a live read at block 25678182. Not speculation on future code: the code exists at b9391b1.
dedupReasoning: See PR24-01. Distinguishing test applied: does the PR24-01 remediation (add require(!v2.paused()) to _phase7_phlimboV3Assertions) close PR24-02? No — v3.apySetInProgress() and v3.desiredAPYBps() remain unread by Phase 7 and by VerifyPromotionReady. And PR24-02 carries a sequencing constraint of its own (the mirror assertion must be ordered against step 11, which zeroes V2) that has no analogue in PR24-01.
